content.text: Invariant bound `i <= size + 1` is too weak: slices go out of bounds and the exit doesn't give `i == size`.

input.command:
cat > diagnosis.json <<'EOF'
{"spec_element": "invariant",
 "proof_obligation": "bridge",
 "diagnosis": "The loop invariant bound 0 <= i <= size + 1 is too weak. It allows i == size + 1, so ret[..i] and a[l..l+i] in the next invariant may exceed ret.Length / a.Length (well-formedness errors at line 19), and on exit !(i < size) does not imply i == size, so ret[..i] == a[l..l+i] does not yield the postcondition ret[..] == a[l..r]. Fix: tighten to 0 <= i <= size."}
EOF
sed -i 's/invariant 0 <= i <= (size) + 1/invariant 0 <= i <= size/' program.dfy && dafny verify program.dfy

content.text:
I fixed the loop invariant in `copyArr`, and `program.dfy` now verifies: Dafny reports 9 verified, 0 errors.

**What was wrong:** the invariant at line 18 was `0 <= i <= (size) + 1`. That upper bound is off by one, which caused all three errors:
- **Slice errors (line 19):** because `i` was allowed to equal `size + 1`, the slices `ret[..i]` and `a[l..(l + i)]` could run past the end of `ret` or `a`.
- **Postcondition error (the "bridge" failure):** when the loop exits, Dafny only knows `!(i < size)`. With the loose bound, that doesn't force `i == size`, so `ret[..i] == a[l..(l + i)]` doesn't lead to `ensures ret[..] == a[l..r]`.

**Fix:** I tightened it to `invariant 0 <= i <= size`. This is the only change; the rest of the file is untouched. I wrote `diagnosis.json` before editing, classifying this as an `invariant` / `bridge` problem.
